answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The dune is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the oasis. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ledge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
